name: application-price-ticker-strip
title: Price Ticker Strip
description: Scrolling and flash-updating asset price ticker components with up/down coloring, for finance and crypto dashboards.
useWhen: Scrolling and flash-updating asset price ticker components with up/down coloring, for finance and crypto dashboards.
avoidWhen: Avoid price ticker strip when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Price Ticker Strip uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
